fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2 at 2b06f1f3: rhiza workflow check plan and plan-milestone pass, and describe shows pr-green on.fail -> pr-green-infra -> pr-green-infra-wait -> pr-green, and the same loop for rebased-green. The builtin plan.toml and plan-milestone.toml have the infra steps (ship check --infra, max_visits 4; wait until ship check --settled --changed --rerun-infra, 6h/30s, max_visits 3) and green steps at max_visits 4. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/plan-workflow-ci' passes all 4 scripts. plan-workflow-ci-infra-wait uses a repo plan.toml that differs from the builtin only in wait timeout/interval (checked by diff). It fixes attempt 1's finding: the fake gh turns green only on the third rerun, gh.log shows that rerun right after a --rerun-infra poll, and the run passes through pr-green-infra-wait into rebase, merge and close-out. plan-workflow-ci-infra-timeout ends the run on the wait's timeout, with 'an infra failure' in the detail.
